hero_title: Wallpapers for those who live in Gotham's shadows.
hero_text: A collection of original artworks inspired by the Dark Knight aesthetic — rain-soaked rooftops, cold neon and the beam of light cutting through the night. Made for screens, not storefronts.
hero_meta: 4K format · Desktop and mobile · Original file, no watermark
package_text: 42 compositions organized into six atmospheres, from the tower rooftop to the rain-soaked alley. No artwork repeats, and each one comes in three aspect ratios (desktop, mobile and lock screen).
bonus1_text: Color codes from every artwork, ready to use in icons, system themes or other projects.
bonus2_text: Square versions of the six main atmospheres, ready for app folders and widgets.
bonus3_text: A short step-by-step guide to set dynamic wallpapers according to the time of day.
pricing_title: The complete archive, delivered straight to your device
feature2: Three aspect ratios per artwork (desktop, mobile and lock screen)
faq1_q: What format do the artworks come in?
faq1_a: All images are delivered in high-resolution JPG (4K), organized by atmosphere and screen ratio.
faq2_q: Does it work on mobile and desktop?
faq2_a: Yes. Every artwork includes a mobile version, a desktop version and a lock-screen version.
faq3_a: No. Payment is made once and the download remains available to you permanently.
faq4_a: Yes. You have 7 calendar days after purchase to request a full refund with no questions asked.
